d:
Relive the golden era of Bollywood romance with “Main Koi Aisa Geet Gaoon” from the movie Yes Boss (1997), featuring the evergreen pair Shah Rukh Khan & Juhi Chawla.
This beautiful love song captures pure emotions, innocence, and the magic of 90’s Hindi cinema.
A timeless romantic melody that still touches hearts with its soulful lyrics and unforgettable music. Perfect for all SRK fans, 90’s Bollywood lovers, and anyone who believes in true love through music
Movie: Yes Boss (1997)
Starring: Shah Rukh Khan, Juhi Chawla
Song: Main Koi Aisa Geet Gaoon
Genre: Romantic / Melody / Bollywood Classic
